title: Review pagination
guidance: Do not render Previous on page 1. Keep a stable compact page indicator and preserve useful keyboard position after filtering or paging.
Latest human direction: remove bulky rest borders from compact arrow pagination globally; restrained circular hover/focus treatment with full accessible target and labels.

Latest human correction: make compact arrow paging hover more noticeable. Use a soft tonal circular fill plus a fine inset edge on enabled Previous/Next. This icon-navigation exception does not change quiet text-button hover.

decisions.title: Omit unavailable edge controls
decisions.reason: First page does not render Previous. Last page does not render Next. Keep the page count centered in a stable layout.

decisions.title: Enlarged text keeps useful page context
decisions.reason: At narrow200% text,48px arrow controls flank a flexible page indicator with8px gaps; the indicator wraps as a phrase rather than one word per line.

decisions.title: 1.8 quiet arrow pagination
decisions.reason: Compact arrow controls have no rest border/shadow, keep full targets and accessible labels, and use a restrained circular hover plus keyboard ring. First/last unavailable directions remain omitted.

decisions.title: Discoverable compact pagination hover
decisions.reason: Shared compact+quiet recipe covers My Jobs and Reviews. Rest is transparent/borderless, targets do not shift, focus remains explicit, touch does not retain hover and reduced motion keeps static feedback.

parameters.name: Pager
parameters.description: Normal grid2.875rem / auto /2.875rem. Narrow enlarged grid48px / minmax(0,1fr) /48px; arrows24px.

parameters.name: Focus
parameters.description: Next/Previous/filter refresh focuses Verified reviews; omitted edge controls are absent from tab order and DOM.

parameters.name: Compact icon hover
parameters.description: Enabled compact quiet icons use a tonal circle and inset hairline on pointer hover. Quiet text controls remain transparent.
